capabilities: Import a Wolai HTML ZIP export
Import CSV or Excel records into a native Base
extras: Needs Obsidian Desktop 1.15.1 or later; command names are in Chinese; writes a migration report to _wolai/迁移报告.md and points to an illustrated walkthrough elsewhere.
problem: Wolai exports arrive as an HTML ZIP with attachments and no direct way to turn them into linked Obsidian notes.

relations.evidence: Move your Wolai notes to Obsidian in one step after export.

summary: Importer that moves a Wolai HTML ZIP export into an Obsidian vault, keeping page hierarchy, layouts, attachments and links.
